scope: Diagnostic EventPipe sampled thread stacks plus GC/contention/threading events, with native phase timing. Thread samples include waiting and are not exact on-CPU time. The two builds share final native; no qualified performance claim or production edit.

trace_tool.scope: Files of the installed profiler apphost and managed tool directory, captured before diagnostic collection; production hosts untouched.

hash_origin.validation: Matching path, byte size and nanosecond mtime; earlier content SHA reused.
